spec_match.rationale: The before/after reference columns describe the change accurately, and the page now records the visitor's own drag — pointerdown/move, dragstart, pointercancel, collapsed drag stream, dragend — and judges which column the real sequence matched.

interactive.rationale: Live recorder added this pass: a draggable chip captures every trusted pointer/drag event into a sequence list with a verdict; clear button resets. The 'Viewer' finally views.

blurb_alignment.rationale: 'Expected vs actual' is now literal — the actual sequence is recorded beside the expected columns.

edge_cases.rationale: Runs without a dragstart (touch, too-short drags) get an honest not-diagnostic verdict; mixed recordings are reported as such; pre-drag pointermove runs and the continuous drag stream are collapsed to keep the list legible.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus 6732314958757888, MDN pointercancel, and the HTML DnD spec.

conformance.rationale: The recorder is a live check of exactly the contract the feature suite describes.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via trusted CDP mouse input: a real 240px drag recorded [pointerdown → pointermove → dragstart → pointercancel (at dragstart) → drag → dragend] and the verdict correctly matched the 148+ column — a genuinely interesting measurement, since this build predates the chromestatus milestone yet already exhibits the fixed sequence; the recorder reports engine truth rather than assuming version behavior. 0px overflow both classes; zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: Recorder reuses the sequence-list idiom; badge contrast resolved by this pass's site-wide accent darkening (emerald now 5.24:1 on ivory).

accessibility.rationale: Recorded list is aria-labelled and aria-live; verdict role=status; chip is keyboard-reachable text content with the interaction honestly mouse/touch-bound (native DnD limitation, stated).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000 (re-measured after fix); touch limitations of native DnD are disclosed in the stage copy.

openQuestions.title: Capture a genuine legacy-column recording
openQuestions.detail: This build already produces the fixed sequence, so the legacy interleaving verdict path has no live capture yet — record one on an older engine (or platform still on the pre-148 path) to complete the evidence pair.

guidanceConsulted.query: event sequence live recorder drag pointer events
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Show real event streams rather than only describing them.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied in this pass's fix: trusted-event recorder with per-run verdict.

guidanceConsulted.query: live list updates announce recorded events
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce dynamic list content via live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Sequence list aria-live polite + labelled; verdict role=status.

summary: Re-reviewed after an in-place fix this pass (headless, trusted CDP input; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the page now records real drags and judges them against its reference columns — and the first recording overturned this review's own assumption, showing the 148+ sequence live on a nominally pre-148 build. Exactly why the recorder needed to exist.
